The main takeaway from our work is that
a phase II trial can be interrupted by a clinical hold, even if the study has been ongoing for only 2 years and the patient population is small (N = 24).
a phase II study can be put on a clinical halt due to safety concerns in other phase II or phase III studies with the same drug.
